retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist, high-contrast digital collage featuring diamond-encrusted typography, luxury symbols, and symmetrical character placement over a dramatic sunset mansion backdrop.
triggerTerms: luxury mansion with fire and sports cars
excludeWhen: subtle or muted color palettes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, layered composition featuring two central figures flanking a vertical focal point (a jeweled dagger), set against a luxury estate with fire, sports cars, and a diamond-bordered frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical character placement flanking a central vertical axis
Foreground fire elements framing the bottom and sides
Large-scale 3D title text arching across the top third
Central vertical anchor provided by a jeweled dagger in a fountain
Repetitive diamond texture applied to borders and typography
coreInvariants: High-contrast red and gold color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary figures in the upper mid-ground, scaled to dominate the top half; a central dagger acts as the primary vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, diamond-encrusted dagger standing vertically in a pool of blood/water at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched 3D title, moves down the central dagger, then outward to the flanking figures and cars.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with textures, fire, and architectural details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and orange (fire, sunset, blood)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold and silver (jewelry, car accents, dagger hilt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and oranges; high value contrast between dark shadows and brilliant white diamond glints.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with an arched baseline
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick 3D extrusions with gold metallic sides
Face of letters filled with a crushed diamond/glitter texture
Heavy black drop shadows to separate text from the background
Occasional 'dripping' liquid effects from the bottom of letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are arched to follow a convex curve
Sparkle 'glint' icons placed on corners of letters

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the sky and characters

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine massive 3D display type with small, traditional blackletter or gothic script for secondary details.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the diamond texture fill
Matches the secondary gothic script used for detail text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical collage featuring a luxury mansion at sunset, two sports cars (white and red) in the driveway, palm trees, and a central fountain. Add fire flames in the foreground corners and a diamond-studded gold frame around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D arched text at the top with a diamond-crusted face and gold beveled edges. Place a jeweled dagger vertically in the center foreground.

verificationChecks: Is the border a continuous line of diamonds?
Does the main text have a visible 3D gold extrusion?
Are there fire elements in the bottom corners?

adjustableVariables: Type of jewelry on the central dagger
Curvature of the top text arch
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos on the cars
Ensure the diamond texture is a generic pattern
postGenerationChecks: Verify 3D depth of the main title
Ensure fire does not obscure the main subjects
Confirm the border is perfectly rectangular and studded
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical luxury collage + 3D diamond-crusted arched typography + fire and gold accents + diamond-studded frame.
